summary: Builds a 4x4 rotation matrix into the 16-float output buffer a1 from the angle a2. Computes v3 = cos(a2) and v4 = sin(a2), then writes the 2x2 rotation block [[v3, v4], [-v4, v3]] in the first two rows, zeros elsewhere except 1.0 at a1[10] and a1[15], and returns the input matrix pointer a1 unchanged. A standalone math helper; the prelabel identifies it as a structural twin of F_4x4MatrixMultiply (0050cbb6), cluster_copy, DERIVED.

local_names.a1: output 4x4 float matrix buffer (16 contiguous floats)
local_names.a2: rotation angle in radians, source of the cosine/sine coefficients

operations.description: Compute the trigonometic coefficients: v3 = cos(a2) and v4 = sin(a2); both are used to fill the rotation sub-block.
Write the top-left 2x2 rotation sub-block: a1[0] = v3, a1[1] = v4, a1[4] = -v4, a1[5] = v3.
Write the second column of the rotation block as zeros: a1[2] = 0.0, a1[3] = 0.0, a1[6] = 0.0, a1[7] = 0.0.
Return the input matrix pointer a1 unchanged as the result.
